name: Take at the first traded book, closed at the SP
hypothesis: A back taken at a dog's first traded book where the price is 8%+ over the forecast SP, its winnings laid at the SP at once, earns the gap to the SP.

evidence.claim: real orders only with GREYHOUND_TAKE_CLOSE=live and a daily loss limit; paper by default
a lead, not a proven edge: 1 of 238 trade-out rules, about 2.6 pass by chance
forward test and its reading registered before the first order

approved.source: the owner, 18 Nov 2026: "Run the take-and-close LIVE", "GBP100 a bet", its own STOP (greyhound/take_close.py docstring)
